en.headline: Science Museum opens Future Science Prize Exhibition until 18 November
en.dek: The ground-floor show highlights this year's three laureates and past Hong Kong winners through multimedia and interactive displays on topics including autophagy and mesoporous materials.
body: The Hong Kong Science Museum began presenting the 2026 Future Science Prize Exhibition on Friday at the Exhibition Hall on the ground floor. The display runs until 18 November and focuses on science in daily life.

This year's Life Science Prize went to Dr Zhang Hong for work on autophagy mechanisms in multicellular organisms. The Physical Science Prize was awarded to Professor Zhao Dongyuan for contributions to mesoporous materials, and Professor Yuan Xinyi received the Mathematics and Computer Science Prize for arithmetic geometry.

Interactive exhibits cover past winning fields such as cryptography, single-atom catalysis and hepatitis virus research. The organisers said a Science Summit will be held at the museum on 6 and 7 November as part of Future Science Prize Week.

zh.headline: 科學館舉行2026未來科學大獎展覽至11月18日
zh.dek: 地下展覽廳以「生活中的科學」為題，介紹本年度三位得主及歷年香港獲獎者，設多媒體互動展品。
body: 香港科學館今日起至11月18日在地下展覽廳舉行「2026未來科學大獎展覽」。展覽以生活中的科學為主題，展示本年度及歷年香港獲獎科學家的研究成果。
本年度生命科學獎由張宏博士獲得，表彰他在多細胞生物自噬機制方面的貢獻。物質科學獎頒予趙東元教授，數學與計算機科學獎則由袁新意教授獲得。
展覽設有互動展品，涵蓋密碼學、單原子催化及肝炎病毒等領域。主辦方表示，11月6及7日將在館內舉行科學峰會，屬未來科學大獎周的活動。
